question: The supplementary drug protection certificate is extended, within the protection granted to the base patent, when:

options.opa: The product is not protected by a valid patent.
options.opb: The product has already been subject to a certificate of protection.
options.opc: The marketing authorization is not the first one granted to the product as a medicine.
options.opd: The product, as a medicine, has been the subject of a marketing authorization in accordance with the standards issued by the European Community.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: The product is not protected by a valid patent -> Supplementary drug protection certificate is extended -> 80% CHAIN: The product has already been subject to a certificate of protection -> Supplementary drug protection certificate is extended -> 75% CHAIN: The marketing authorization is not the first one granted to the product as a medicine -> Supplementary drug protection certificate is extended -> 70% CHAIN: The product, as a medicine, has been the subject of a marketing authorization in accordance with the standards issued by the European Community -> Supplementary drug protection certificate is extended -> 80%
analysis: The supplementary drug protection certificate is extended when the product, as a medicine, has been the subject of a marketing authorization in accordance with the standards issued by the European Community.
